description: This Java class represents the domain entity 'Likelihood' used in the survey infrastructure of the Fineract project. It manages likelihood data for PPI surveys, including fields for name, ID, and enabled status, and provides methods for updating its state based on commands.

classes.name: Likelihood
classes.description: Entity class that models likelihood data in the survey module, with fields for PPI name, likelihood ID, and enabled status. It extends AbstractPersistableCustom for persistence support and includes methods to update its state and check activation commands.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the enabled status of the likelihood based on a JsonCommand object, returning a map of actual changes.

methods.name: isActivateCommand
methods.description: Checks if the given JsonCommand indicates an activation command based on the 'ACTIVE' parameter.
